purpose: Phase 1 of the 5/3 addition: independent second implementation (implementation B with two-direction contraction) through all ten stages and stage-by-stage comparison with the handoff producer.

b_two_direction.command: g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -o wgb supplement/computations/word_b/wgb.cpp; wgb pipeline --a 5 --b 3 --K 3 --carries -2,2,4 --primes 7,11,13,17,19,23,29,31,37 --bidir --out OUT

comparison.command: compare_five_thirds.py --canon canon_wordgraph --b-dir OUT --b-json stages-two-direction.jsonl --a-prefix PREFIX --a-json producer-full-result.json --stages 10 --out comparison.json --elementwise TMP

b_forward_only.note: Existing pipeline (no in-direction contraction) through prime 31; the lift to 37 was counted, not formed.

b_default_pipeline_regression.command: previous and extended wgb, pipeline mode without new options, for 5/2 (K=4, primes 3..31) and 7/5 (K=2048, primes 3,11,13)
b_default_pipeline_regression.result: all stage graph files byte-identical; JSON lines identical apart from timing fields

normalisation: canon_wordgraph CANON1. B's vertices (q, cell) are ordered by (cell, q mod p_1, ..., q mod p_k) for the primes in the order used; the producer's vertex indices are used as dumped (its dump has cell bounds only). Edges are distinct (u, v, word) triples sorted by u, v and word. The two canonical texts are compared byte for byte and by SHA-256.

provenance.clean_room: The in-direction (two-direction) extension of wgb.cpp was written from the lemma 'Two-direction exact contraction' and the iteration rule in the handoff manuscript (manuscript/addition_body.tex), without opening certificate53.cpp, audit_basic.hpp or reference53.py. Those files were only compiled and executed as black boxes until the comparison was complete. The dump format was read from the handoff README/PROOF_JA.md and the recorded small dumps, and the producer's invocation from its driver reproduce.py and handoff.py.
provenance.authors: wgb.cpp was written earlier by a different programmer from the mathematical specification; the --bidir, --no-graphs and --count-next-lift options, canon_wordgraph.cpp and compare_five_thirds.py were added in a separate AI-assisted session (Claude Code). The producer and its checker were written in another AI session (the handoff).
